title: Lantern Lane
tagline: Gather the lost lights, deliver the letters, and light the tree.
pitch: Lantern Lane: a cozy evening village collect-a-thon. Wander a warm little town at golden hour as a cat, gather lost lanterns and letters for the neighbours, chat with friendly villagers, and light the big lantern tree in the plaza. Soft acoustic music, a cozy rounded HUD, no rush.
controls: Walk up to a villager: chat

plan.title: Lantern Lane
plan.tagline: Gather the lost lights, deliver the letters, and light the tree.
plan.core_loop: Wander the golden-hour village, gather the lanterns and letters the villagers ask for, deliver them, and chat — every completed quest brings the plaza's great lantern tree closer to lighting up.
controls: Walk up to a villager: chat
plan.win_condition: Complete all four villager quests, then light the big lantern tree in the plaza.
plan.lose_condition: None — no timer, no enemies, no lives to lose. The evening is yours.

npcs.name: Bramble
lines: My porch light went out, little one.
Find me four lanterns and I'll share the master light.
You're the reason this lane glows.

npcs.name: Wren
lines: The wind scattered my letters again.
Three of them — check the hedges and the well.
A village runs on letters, you know.

npcs.name: Pip
lines: Just say hi to everyone, that's all I ask.
You'll light the tree, won't you?

npcs.name: Milo
lines: I saved you a seat by the tree!
Mama says the tree lights when the lane is ready.
Bring the big lantern when you can!

plan.art_direction: Warm apricot-and-honey palette at golden hour deepening to dusk violet at the edges, with long soft shadows and a gentle rim light on every rounded form. Low-poly coziness: round cottages with glowing amber windows, cobbled lanes, sagging string lights, and paper lanterns as the recurring motif. Mood is unhurried and gently magical — Totoro's evening village meets Animal Crossing dusk, with fireflies drifting in the air.
concept_shots: The ginger cat in a cream scarf stands on a cobbled lane at golden hour; string lights sag between round cottages, windows glow amber, and three paper lanterns bob in the grass ahead.
The plaza at dusk: the big lantern tree, its branches heavy with unlit paper lanterns, villagers seated on benches, the cat carrying a glowing master lantern toward the trunk.
A close moment: the cat hands a letter to Wren the frog by the well; a soft sparkle burst pops and a quest toast slides in on the cozy rounded HUD.

assets.sky: Golden-hour panorama: apricot and honey gradient sinking into dusk violet, a big low sun, soft puffy clouds lit from below, distant hills, and the first stars.

plan.mapping_notes: Cat hero → Player.makeCharacter with species 'cat' and a 'scarf' accessory, platformer + follow camera so it can hop over hedges and fences. Cozy evening village → Look 'cozy' (warm palette, soft shadows) + Level 'town' (dressed village: houses, benches, well, stalls, lantern posts, plaza); the golden-hour fantasy is carried by the generated sky panorama and the warm lantern props. The pitch's two pickup types (lanterns AND letters) → the kit has one primary collectible (lanterns, 12 placed), while letters live on as quest items via fetch/deliver quests in quests mode, so both appear in the world and the HUD. Big lantern tree → the goal (goal: true) placed in the plaza, dressed with the custom lantern_tree prop; lighting it is reaching the goal once quests are done. 'No rush' → timer 0, lives 0, enemies 0, race laps 0. Cozy rounded HUD → UI.setStyle('cozy'). Chatting villagers → quests-mode NPCs with UI.dialog bubbles. Fireflies and lantern glow → FX kit touches.
features: Drifting fireflies: gentle sparkle particles (FX.sparkles) over the lanes and plaza at dusk
Lantern glow: warm sparkle burst + chime on every lantern pickup (FX.sparkle, FX.burst)
Villager dialog bubbles: UI.dialog shows each neighbour's lines when the cat is near
Quest tracker: UI.objective + UI.toasts update as each villager's request is completed
Tree-lighting finale: confetti, a light ring, and a warm flash (FX.confetti, FX.ring, FX.flash) with a brief slow-mo as the tree blooms
Cozy rounded HUD: lantern/letter counters and a quest list, no timer shown

result.summary: Lantern Lane is built on the scaffold: a cozy golden-hour town quest adventure. The cat hero (scarf, apricot/cream) wanders the medium 'town' level, gathers glowing paper lanterns (8 on the route, tagged from the level's coins) plus 3 letters I placed off-route for Wren, and works through the four villager quests (Bramble fetch-4 lanterns, Wren fetch-3 letters, Pip talk, and a deliver quest Bramble→Milo for the master lantern). All quests done + lantern target opens the goal portal in the plaza, where the generated lantern-tree prop stands as the centerpiece. Cozy rounded HUD with lantern/letter counters, minimap and live objective; title screen sells the fantasy; firefly sparkles drift over the plaza; letter pickups, quest completions and the quests-done banner get toasts; the win fires a warm flash, confetti, a light ring and magic burst at the tree with a brief slow-mo. Autopilot verified: moves along the route, collects lanterns and letters, and completes Bramble's quest with zero console errors.
changes: Tagged level collectibles as 'lantern' and set collect target to 8 (matches what the level actually places)
Added 3 'letter' collectibles off-route for Wren's fetch quest, placed via route-side offsets with World.heightAt
Placed the generated prop_lantern_tree beside the plaza goal as the centerpiece, with an always-on warm sparkle glow
Fixed the deliver quest (from/to must be NPC names: Bramble → Milo) so Gameplay.rules no longer throws
Added HUD objective line and a second letter counter
Added event juice: letter-pickup toasts, questDone toasts, 'The lane is ready!' banner on questsDone, and a win finale (ring + magic at the tree, confetti, warm flash, slow-mo)
Shortened the title subtitle to fit the cozy plate
known_issues: The 'letters' HUD counter is driven by the quest system, not a state key, so it may stay at 0 even as letters are picked up (lantern counter works correctly)
The deliver quest's auto-generated objective text reads 'Pick up the Bring the master lantern to the tree from Bramble' — the label string leaks into the template; the quest itself works fine
Win flow (tree-lighting FX) is wired but not exercised by the short autopilot runs; it triggers on the 'win' event after all quests + goal
